messages:
tara (People Ops): Heads up — launching a new lightweight template called the Objective Impact Ledger (OIL). It's meant to help ICs and managers link each objective to traceable impact artifacts. Preview: https://go.redwood/oil-preview. Please pilot with your teams this cycle.
alex (Eng): Curious — how is OIL different from traditional OKR descriptions?
tara (People Ops): Good Q. OKRs remain the outcome language. OIL is a short ledger you keep alongside each objective that records: exact metric change, data source, artifact link (PR/dash/incident), owner, and short interpretation sentence. Think: evidence-first, one-line summaries.
mohit (PM): Sounds useful for product folks. Any examples for qualitative work (research, retention experiments)?
tara (People Ops): Yes — we included three templates: metric-driven, experiment/research, and customer-story. Example (research):
```
Objective: Improve onboarding activation rate by 15%
Artifact: User interviews (n=12) + funnel analysis
Metric change: Activation from 28% -> 33% (A/B 95% conf, 2026-04-02)
Source: analytics.redwood.com/funnels/onboard
Owner: moh-it@redwood
Interpretation: interview themes + funnel lift suggest friction removal on step 2 drove activation gains
```
paula (Manager): Would like phrasing helpers for managers when reviewing OIL entries — quick things to say to nudge better evidence.
tara (People Ops): Added a 'Manager Phrases' section in the doc:
- "Nice: links + dated metric. Can you add the experiment ID for traceability?"
- "Can you clarify sampling window and segmentation used for this metric?"
- "Good qualitative signal; add a short quote and link to raw notes for reviewers."
checklist-bot: Reminder: Performance calibration prep deadline 2026-05-15.
alex (Eng): Timeline — should teams keep OIL live or just fill at check-ins?
tara (People Ops): Prefer live updates but we will snapshot at mid-cycle and final review. Recommendation: add 1 quick line per week or after key artifacts (PR merged, experiment ended).
mohit (PM): Any automation planned? e.g., pulling dashboard links or PRs into ledger?
tara (People Ops): We're exploring light integrations: auto-link detection and tag suggestions. For now it's manual but we're building a v0 script to detect linked dashboards.
paula (Manager): Request: can People Ops create a 3-row "starter OIL" for ICs who want minimal overhead?
tara (People Ops): Done — one-pager starter OIL included in the preview. If teams want a live 10-min walkthrough, DM me and I'll drop into a sync. :sparkles:
